changelog: 🔍 Ripgrep-Grade Search Engine in Rust (`agy_ide_bridge_rs`): Instant sub-millisecond search across workspaces with .gitignore compliance, binary file skipping, regex support, and exact character position matching.
⚡ Semantic Git Diff Engine (`similar` crate): Fast hunk-by-hunk diff parser for live repository changes and arbitrary text diff computation via `/api/diff` and `/api/git/diff`.
🦀 870 KB Packaged Asset: Slashed memory and binary overhead while delivering desktop-grade IDE performance on Android.
